text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High error rate detected for customer 'Montage Systems' on endpoint `claims.ingest.v2` — 5xx spike, 503s increasing over last 6m. Paging SRE oncall.

Mike (SRE Oncall): I'm on it. grabbing logs and tracing, will own the on-call handoff.

Ajay (Eng): thx — I can help with rollback if we need to revert the recent model rollout to v2-quant. seeing increased tail latency on the model service.

Dylan (Eng-SRE): routing: dedicated pool mntg-eu-1 showing GPU OOMs then 503s. autoscaler attempted instance replacement 3x, failed healthchecks.

Mike (SRE Oncall): OK — immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale down to fallback model (v2-fp16) for Montage routing policy 2) pause new batch file ingestion from their partner queue 3) create status page update. Doing step 1 now.

Ajay (Eng): rollback command ready:
```
# rollback model routing
redwood route update --customer montage --model v2-fp16 --weight 100
```
I can run with Mike.

Mike (SRE Oncall): ran rollback and verified 200 OKs on smoke checks. latency back within SLO for small requests. continuing monitoring.

Lina (Customer Success): Montage CSMs on standby. Can we get a short tailored impact blurb I can send to their escalation list? They want messaging for billing team and engineering integrators.

Mike (SRE Oncall): Suggested customer notification (please edit as needed):
"Hi Montage team — we detected elevated 5xx errors impacting claims ingestion (endpoint `claims.ingest.v2`) starting at 08:07 UTC. We rolled traffic to a compatible fallback model and verified successful processing for new requests. Impact: intermittent failures for some ingestion jobs between 08:07–08:18 UTC, retrying succeeded for most. Action taken: rollback to v2-fp16 and instance replacements; full capacity restore in progress. Next update in 30m or when we have root cause. We apologize for the disruption — contact your CS rep Lina for immediate concerns."

Lina (Customer Success): OK I will send that. Please add the account contact routing below so CS can cc the right people.

Dylan (Eng-SRE): Montage account contacts (from account metadata) — use this routing:
- Primary technical: montage-eng@montage-sys.internal (integration team)
- Billing ops: billing-montage@montage-internal (billing queue)
- Exec sponsor: tara@montage-exec (escalation only)
- CS rep: lina@redwood (for recipient visibility)
(also note: customer prefers email + status page notice)

Mike (SRE Oncall): Draft status page update (post to https://status.redwood.ai):
```
Incident: Intermittent 5xx errors for Montage Systems — Claims Ingest (claims.ingest.v2)
Start time: 2026-03-17 08:07 UTC
Current status: Mitigated — traffic routed to compatible fallback model; processing resumed for most customers. Engineers continuing remediation and capacity restoration.
Impact: Some ingestion jobs for Montage may have failed and retried; latency may have increased for a subset of requests.
Next update: 30 minutes or earlier with RCA.
```

Lina (Customer Success): Sending email to contacts now with the message and linking status page. I'll paste the sent copy here.

OpsBot: Email sent to montage-eng@montage-sys.internal, billing-montage@montage-internal, tara@montage-exec, cc: lina@redwood. Delivery confirmed.

Mike (SRE Oncall): Monitoring: error rate trending down to baseline. Autoscaler logs show two failed node boots due to a driver mismatch; rolling nodes replaced successfully after manual remediation. Investigating root cause with infra team.

Ajay (Eng): note for RCA: recent kernel/driver package pushed to the dedicated image on 03/16 may mismatch with cuDNN binary used by model runtime. Will coordinate image pin rollback and repro on staging.

Lina (Customer Success): Montage acknowledged receipt and asked for an ETA on full restore and a customer-facing RCA. They requested logs for failed job IDs; I told them we'll follow up after RCA.

Mike (SRE Oncall): Assigning follow-ups: 1) Ajay — image pin + repro (owner) 2) Dylan — verify full capacity restore for mntg-eu-1 (owner) 3) Mike — publish interim RCA draft by EOD and coordinate final RCA with CS.

Dylan (Eng-SRE): capacity looks stable now. I'll keep 15-min checks for the next 2 hours.

Mike (SRE Oncall): Closing loop for on-call: handing off to next oncall in 2h. If any re-escalation, page SRE follow-on.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation successful, monitoring. Incident will remain open for RCA tracking.

Lina (Customer Success): Customer notification copy (what I sent):
"Montage team — quick update: We mitigated an elevated error rate impacting claims ingestion by routing to a fallback model; most requests are processing successfully. We're preparing a detailed RCA and will share within 24 hours. Contact: lina@redwood for urgent items. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3842002468"

Mike (SRE Oncall): Thanks all. tagging this thread to the incident ticket #INC-3842 for postmortem.
